QC-HOME-014 — Quick Contact Us Section
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-014 | US001 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Contact Us Section — Visitor Display & Form Submission
As a
public website visitor
I want
to view Qatar Chamber's contact details and submit an
enquiry via the contact form on the Home Page
So that
I can easily get in touch with Qatar Chamber for
enquiries, support, or information
Preconditions:
- The Contact Us section is published and active in the
CMS.
- At least one inquiry category is configured and active.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls to the Contact Us section on the Home
Page.
2. The section renders in two columns: contact details on the
left (email, phone, Location/Address, embedded map) and the contact form on the
right.
3. Visitor reads the contact details: Email address, Telephone
number, and location address.
4. Visitor views the embedded Google Maps map showing the
Qatar Chamber location.
5. Visitor fills in the form: Full Name, Email Address,
Inquiry Category (dropdown), and Message.
6. Visitor clicks Send Message without filling all required
fields — inline validation messages appear under each empty required field.
7. Visitor corrects errors, fills all fields with valid data,
and clicks Send Message
8. System submits the form and displays a success
confirmation message.
Given the
visitor scrolls to the Contact Us section
When the
section renders
Then
- the system shall display the section tag, heading, and
description in the active language.
- the system shall display the contact details: email
address, telephone number, and location address (bilingual).
- the system shall display an embedded map showing the
Qatar Chamber location.
- the system shall display a contact form with: Full Name
(text), Email Address (email), Inquiry Category (dropdown), and Message (text
area) fields.
- the system shall display a Send Message CTA button.
- Fill the Captcha (Google Captcha)
And when the visitor submits the form
- If Full Name is empty: "Full Name is
required." الاسم الكامل مطلوب.
- If Email Address is empty: "E-mail Address is
required." عنوان البريد الإلكتروني مطلوب.
- If Email Address is invalid: "Please enter a valid
email address." يرجى إدخال عنوان بريد إلكتروني صالح.
- If Inquiry Category is not selected: "Inquiry
Category is required." فئة الاستفسار مطلوبة.
- If Message is empty: "Message is required." الرسالة
مطلوبة.
- If all fields are valid and the form is submitted
successfully, the system shall display a success confirmation message in the
active language.
- if the submission fails due to a backend error:
"Unable to send your message. Please try again later." تعذّر إرسال رسالتك.
يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى لاحقاً.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If the Inquiry Category dropdown has no active options,
the dropdown shall display a placeholder with no selectable items.
- If the embedded map fails to load, the location address
shall still display as plain text.
Post Condition:
- Visitor's enquiry is successfully submitted and routed
to the configured recipient email address(es).
BACKEND — Admin CMS
Management
User Story ID
QC-HOME-014 | US002 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Contact Us Section — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to manage the Contact, us section on the Home Page —
including contact details, inquiry categories, and form recipient
configuration — in Liferay CMS
So that
visitor enquiries are correctly routed and the contact
section displays accurate information
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate role to manage Home Page
content in Liferay CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Home Page → Contact Us Section Management.
3. Enters the section heading and description (bilingual).
4. Enters the email support address, telephone number, and
location address (bilingual).
5. Configures the map embed URL or coordinates for the
embedded map.
6. Manages inquiry categories: label (bilingual), display
order, active status.
7. Enters the form recipient email address(es) for contact
form submissions.
8. Configures the Send Message button label (bilingual).
9. Saves as draft, previews, and publishes the section.
10. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
11. Published configuration reflects on the Home Page Contact
Us section after cache refresh.
Given the admin
opens Contact Us Section management in the CMS
When the admin
configures contact details, inquiry categories, and form settings
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the
section Tag, heading and description (bilingual).
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the email
support address, telephone number, and location address (bilingual).
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the map
embed URL or geographic coordinates.
- The system shall allow the admin to manage inquiry
category items with: label (bilingual), display order, and active status.
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the form
recipient email address(es) for routing submissions.
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the Send
Message button label (bilingual).
- The system shall allow draft,
publish, and unpublish actions.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful action.
And — when a visitor submits the form:
- the system shall route the submission email to the
configured recipient address(es).
Negative Scenarios:
- If mandatory fields are skipped: "{Field Name} is
required." {اسم الحقل} مطلوب.
- If the email support address is invalid: "Please
enter a valid email address." يرجى إدخال عنوان بريد إلكتروني صالح.
- If the map embed URL is invalid: "Please enter a
valid URL." يرجى إدخال رابط صالح.
Post Condition:
- The Contact Us section is published with correct
contact details, inquiry categories, and form routing configuration.
